title: Rename Model Schema Manifest To Document
description: Rename framework kernel and app terminology from model to document for schema manifests: ModelHandle/ModelId/ModelVersion/ModelDiff/ModelKind, ResourceKind::Model, model_projection/model_projection_schema, WIT migrate-model/read-model/write-model, and remaining play.model body keys (shooting).
summary:
Completed plugin binding regeneration for the model→document rename.

- Restored missing WIT exports (list-tools, window-engagements, window-measures) so wasm32 plugin builds succeed.
- Rebuilt all plugin-modules via `bun ./script.ts plugin`; generated JS now uses migrate-document / MigrateDocument* throughout plugin-modules.
- Fixed trinity-plugin wasm build: added missing SurfaceKind::Canvas2d on Parameters window_kind in app_rewrite.rs.
- Transpiled remaining vcs and writer plugins; synced plugin-modules into renderer-modules/wgpu/plugin-modules (stale migrate-model copies removed).

Verification: no migrate-model/MigrateModel references remain under framework/; @semio-tech/framework-renderer-react tests pass (27).
